data.one_liner: Customizable Material Design date and range picker widgets for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides single date pickers, range pickers, and specific day/month/year selection widgets along with dialog helpers. It supports rich theming, custom cell builders, localization, and a view-only mode.
use_when: You need highly customizable Material Design date or range pickers.
You want inline calendar widgets alongside dialog-based date selection.
You need custom cell content such as badges or event markers inside days.
avoid_when: You need a simple time picker rather than a calendar date picker.
You rely on very old deprecated v6 theming API properties without migrating.
strengths: Material 3 friendly out of the box with centralized theming via ThemeExtensions.
Provides cell builders for deep customization of day, month, and year cells.
weaknesses: Inline pickers require explicit container sizing or constrained layouts to avoid layout issues.
Custom non-shape or non-box range decorations require custom painters to handle edge colors.

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative customizable calendar date and range picker package.
